finding.claim: Subject check is skipped when the token has no sub claim (fail-open). Medium, conditional on the issuer minting sub-less tokens. Not executed; from code reading.
finding.source: Validly signed token from the same issuer/key that lacks a sub claim; caller passes subject="alice".
finding.sink: Caller's subject check in _validate_sub, which decides who is authenticated.

trace.note: returns early when 'sub' not in payload

finding.guards_checked: Signature verification runs first. verify_sub defaults true. _validate_iss (api_jwt.py:571-572) and _validate_aud (api_jwt.py:529-532) raise MissingRequiredClaimError when the expected value is given and the claim is absent, so _validate_sub is the inconsistent one.

finding.claim: Cached signing keys (cache_keys=True) are never revoked: a key removed from the JWKS keeps verifying tokens until LRU eviction. Medium-low; documented design. Not executed.
finding.source: Token signed with a key the IdP has removed; cache_keys=True (non-default).
finding.sink: Token acceptance in get_signing_key via cached PyJWK.

trace.note: lookup returns cached key on hit without consulting JWKS
docstring: no time-based expiration, evicted only by size

finding.guards_checked: Signature verification still runs against the cached key. Behaviour is documented in the docstring.

finding.claim: Unknown kid forces an outbound JWKS fetch on every miss, with no rate limit or negative cache. Low. Not executed.
finding.source: Unauthenticated tokens with random kid values.
finding.sink: Outbound HTTP request to the JWKS URI (urlopen, 30s timeout) bypassing the JWK Set cache.

trace.note: get_signing_key_from_jwt reads kid from unverified header

finding.guards_checked: kid must be a string (api_jws.py:446-448). Matching is exact (jwks_client.py:241-246). Nothing bounds fetch frequency.

finding.claim: Private JWK material (d, p, q, k) is embedded in exception messages when kty, crv, or alg checks fail. Low-medium; conflicts with org policy against logging sensitive data. Not executed.
finding.source: A private JWK missing kty, with an unsupported alg (e.g. RSA-OAEP), or missing crv.
finding.sink: Exception text of InvalidKeyError/PyJWKError, which callers commonly log or return.
finding.guards_checked: Other error messages (api_jwk.py:64, :66) include only the crv or kty value. Leak is limited to these three paths.

finding.claim: Redirects are followed past the init-time scheme allowlist (ftp:// reachable) and custom headers such as Authorization are forwarded cross-host. Low, conditional. Not executed; relies on stdlib urllib redirect behaviour as I recall it, which I did not test.
finding.source: JWKS endpoint (or a URI derived from attacker-controlled jku) answering with a 30x redirect; caller configured an Authorization header.
finding.sink: Request to arbitrary host or ftp:// carrying the bearer credential.

trace.note: scheme checked only on initial URI
urlopen follows redirects via stdlib HTTPRedirectHandler

finding.guards_checked: urllib rejects file: on redirect (per recollection). Initial scheme is checked. No host or IP restriction exists.

finding.claim: A malformed JWK (alg none, or oct without k) raises an exception that escapes the PyJWTError filter, so one bad entry aborts loading the whole JWK Set. Low, availability. Not executed.
finding.source: JWKS entry with alg:"none" or kty:"oct" missing k; requires attacker influence over JWKS content.

trace.note: HMACAlgorithm.from_jwk raises KeyError on missing k

finding.guards_checked: Other key types validate required fields before parsing.

finding.claim: Caller-supplied JWKS URI has no host restriction, so a URI derived from attacker input enables SSRF to internal hosts. Low, informational. Not executed.
finding.source: Application builds PyJWKClient from attacker-influenced input (the case the code comment says the scheme check protects against).
finding.sink: Outbound request to any http(s) host, including internal addresses.

trace.note: comment says scheme check protects against attacker-influenced URI

finding.guards_checked: file:, ftp:, data: rejected at init. Host and address unchecked.
